The Ultraviolette X47 has evolved into the X47 Venom, and this is more than just a new colour scheme.
The biggest change is a 20kg weight reduction, but Ultraviolette has also reworked the suspension, improved performance, enhanced thermal efficiency and made charging faster. The result? A motorcycle that feels noticeably more agile, quicker and easier to live with.
We ride the X47 Venom to find out how much difference these updates make in the real world, what still needs work, and whether this is the upgrade the original X47 needed.
